SYLLABUSES FOR THE DEGREE OF BACHELOR OF LAWS (constructed test document, fictional)
1. A candidate shall complete 120 credits of professional core including compulsory
courses and 42 credits of disciplinary electives. Subject to LL11, candidates
shall select 57 credits of courses in their First Year, 63 credits in their
Second Year and 60 credits in each of their Third and Fourth Years.
First Year (57 credits)

LLAW1002 Law of contract II (6 credits)

CAES1001 Academic communication in English2 (non-credit bearing)
CCXXxxxx Common Core course3 (18 credits)
Second Year (63 credits)

all undergraduate students.
